_README: HAND-LABELLED ground truth: what a human would key into a broker from each message. Built after discovering that scoring against stored cards was invalid — many stored cards are FOSSILS from before parser fixes (e.g. 'Price target $212' was captured as the strike, so the card said NVDA 212 when the message plainly says 210). Scoring a model against a buggy card measures conformity to the bug. These labels come from reading the message text only. strike:null means the message genuinely does NOT state a strike — the correct behaviour is to leave it blank and link to the parent watch, so asserting any strike there is a FABRICATION, not a hit. classes[] lists every defensible reading (a resting limit order is fairly called either WATCH or ENTRY); premium_alt allows a stated range.
